Evidence sources are user, environment, tool, file, prior_interaction, or unknown. Use these exact values.
Constraint types are output_format, tool_condition, environment_condition, action_condition, success_criterion, resource_limit, safety_condition, user_preference, or other.
Do not output any additional top-level field, task category, or routing decision.
Do not use task name, dataset name, task id, split, benchmark identity, gold answer, label, target, or evaluator-only fields.
Do not force the interaction into a predefined task category. If evidence is insufficient, use under_specified and keep unsupported constraints absent.
Preserve the meaning of visible evidence. Return one complete valid JSON object only, without markdown or surrounding text. Close every string, array, and object.

Use this exact shape and replace the values: {"evidence":{"items":[{"id":"x1","modality":"text","content":"...","source":"user"}],"summary":"..."},"recognizable_goal":{"status":"explicit","content":"...","supporting_evidence":["x1"]},"recognizable_constraints":[]}
Raw visible input:
